# COMPETITIVE INTELLIGENCE REPORT
**Feature:** Rewards earning rules display (showing users why they earned specific cashback rates)

---

## COMPETITORS

### 1. OneCard | OneCard Credit Card [DIGITAL-FIRST]
**Why relevant:** Digital-first metal card with app-based rewards tracking and transparent earning structure.

**What they built:** OneCard displays reward rates of 0.2% to 2% with targeted offers shown in-app. The app provides a "Simple Rewards" system where users can see earning rates, though specific transaction-level explanations are not detailed in sources.

**One key point:** Focuses on simplicity and app-first experience with metal form factor, but reward rate transparency details are limited in available sources.

**Confidence:** Medium (inferred from app description and review sources)

**Source:** https://cardmaven.in/onecard-review-ltf-metal-credit-card-in-india/ and https://www.cardexpert.in/onecard-review/

---

### 2. Scapia | Scapia Travel Card [DIGITAL-FIRST]
**Why relevant:** Travel-focused digital card with clear earning structure displayed in app for different spend categories.

**What they built:** Scapia shows upfront earning rates (10% rewards on online/offline spends, 5% on UPI) with no caps, displayed prominently in the app. Users can see exactly how coins convert to rupees (5 Scapia Coins = ₹1) and where they can redeem, creating transparency around earning mechanics.

**One key point:** Provides category-specific earning rates with clear conversion ratios, making it easy for users to understand value proposition before and after transactions.

**Confidence:** High (has detailed app store description)

**Source:** https://apps.apple.com/in/app/scapia-a-card-for-travellers/id1625270866 and https://www.scapia.cards/

---

### 3. American Express | Platinum Charge Card [LEGACY BANK]
**Why relevant:** Premium card with Global Dining Credit benefit that shows specific reward amounts and eligibility.

**What they built:** Amex displays the 'Global Dining Credit' benefit (up to £300 over three years) as an exclusive reward for Platinum Cardmembers. The benefit structure is communicated clearly in marketing materials, though transaction-level earning explanations are not detailed in sources.

**One key point:** Uses benefit-based communication rather than transaction-level earning explanations, focusing on tier-based exclusive rewards.

**Confidence:** Low (limited detail in sources about transaction-level display)

**Source:** https://evessio.s3.amazonaws.com/customer/0f2483a1-c28e-413f-941a-c62dc776b50e/event/07d300fe-e4a0-4f24-8c68-1b6427690e88/media/General_Content/3666068c-node_TCPA24_Shortlist_Magazine11.pdf

---

### 4. Revolut | Revolut Metal/Ultra Plans [FINTECH/NBFC]
**Why relevant:** Digital banking app with tiered plans (Premium, Metal, Ultra) that communicate different reward structures.

**What they built:** Revolut launched Metal plan (2018) and Ultra plan (2023) with differentiated benefits, though sources don't detail transaction-level earning explanations. The app redesign (Revolut 10) in 2023 was described as "the most substantive redesign since inception," suggesting enhanced user experience including rewards display.

**One key point:** Focuses on plan-based differentiation with app-first design, but specific earning rule display mechanics are not found in current sources.

**Confidence:** Low (inferred from product evolution, no specific feature details)

**Source:** https://assets.revolut.com/pdf/annualreport2024.pdf

---

### 5. Yotpo | Review Rewards Platform [FINTECH/NBFC]
**Why relevant:** B2B platform that enables merchants to create earning rules and display them to customers for specific actions.

**What they built:** Yotpo provides merchants with tools to create "earning rules" (previously called campaigns) that reward customers for actions like product reviews. The platform shows customers why they earned rewards and allows merchants to configure point awards for specific behaviors, with clear communication of earning mechanics.

**One key point:** Demonstrates B2B approach to earning rule transparency where merchants control display and customers see clear action-to-reward connections.

**Confidence:** High (has detailed documentation)

**Source:** https://support.yotpo.com/docs/creating-a-product-yotpo-review-earning-rule

---

## WHITESPACE SIGNAL

**FIRST-MOVER OPPORTUNITY:** No Indian digital-first card competitor shows transaction-level earning explanations in current sources—most display category rates or plan benefits, but not real-time "why you earned this" messaging post-transaction.

---

## WHAT REAL USERS SAY

**No community signal found in current sources.** The search results contain product descriptions, company reports, and technical documentation but no Reddit discussions or app store reviews specifically about rewards earning rule displays.

---

## GLOBAL BEST PRACTICES SUMMARY

### What Works Globally:

**1. Clear conversion ratios (Scapia model):** Showing simple math (5 coins = ₹1) eliminates confusion and builds trust. Users can instantly calculate value without complex point systems.

**2. Category-specific upfront rates (Scapia model):** Displaying "10% on online, 5% on UPI" before transactions sets expectations and drives behavior toward higher-earning categories.

**3. Action-based earning rules (Yotpo model):** B2B platforms demonstrate that showing "do X, get Y points" with clear eligibility criteria increases engagement and reduces support queries about why rewards weren't earned.

**Source:** https://www.scapia.cards/ and https://support.yotpo.com/docs/creating-a-product-yotpo-review-earning-rule

---

## RBI COMPLIANCE

Not found in current sources. No specific RBI guidelines on rewards earning rule display were present in the search results. The sources contained general credit card rule changes but not specific regulations about how earning mechanics must be communicated to users.

---

## DIFFERENTIATION HYPOTHESES

### Angle 1: Zero-UI Earning Autopsy
**What to build:** Post-transaction push notification that auto-explains earning in plain language ("You earned 2% because this was an online purchase on a weekend") without requiring app open.

**Strategic logic:** Solves the problem at the moment of curiosity (right after transaction) rather than requiring users to hunt for information later—defensive play to reduce confusion.

**RBI compliance:** No specific regulations found in sources; standard transaction notification rules would apply.

**Build complexity:** Low

**Ops impact:** Requires notification infrastructure and earning logic mapping but no new user flows or screens.

---

### Angle 2: Predictive Earning Maximizer
**What to build:** Pre-transaction intelligence that suggests optimal payment method/timing based on user's spending patterns and current offers ("Use PIXEL at this merchant now for 5% vs your usual 2%").

**Strategic logic:** Shifts from reactive explanation to proactive optimization—offensive play that positions PIXEL as a financial advisor, not just a card, creating stickiness through personalized value.

**RBI compliance:** No specific regulations found in sources; would need standard data privacy and consent frameworks.

**Build complexity:** High

**Ops impact:** Requires ML models, real-time offer engine, merchant category mapping, and potential partnerships for location-based triggers.

---

### Angle 3: Social Earning Transparency
**What to build:** In-app feed showing anonymized earning examples from similar users ("Users like you earned 8% average this month on groceries—here's how") with category benchmarks and tips.

**Strategic logic:** Creates relational moment by turning earning rules into community learning—builds engagement through social proof rather than just individual transactions, different target segment (social learners vs solo optimizers).

**RBI compliance:** No specific regulations found in sources; would require anonymization and data protection measures.

**Build complexity:** Medium

**Ops impact:** Requires user segmentation, anonymization engine, content moderation, and community management to prevent gaming or negative sentiment.

---

## RECOMMENDED ANGLE

**Which angle:** Zero-UI Earning Autopsy

**Why now:** PIXEL is building foundational products and needs to establish trust and reduce support load before attempting sophisticated personalization or community features. This angle delivers immediate clarity with minimal technical debt, fits current app notification infrastructure, and solves the core user question ("why did I get this?") without requiring users to learn new interfaces. It's a fast win that builds the data foundation for future sophistication.

**Why not the others:** 
- **Predictive Earning Maximizer:** Requires ML maturity and merchant partnerships PIXEL likely doesn't have yet; high risk of inaccurate predictions damaging trust in early stage.
- **Social Earning Transparency:** Needs critical mass of users and sophisticated anonymization; premature community features can backfire with low engagement or privacy concerns before product-market fit.

---

## OVERALL CONFIDENCE

**Level:** Medium

**Reason:** Found clear examples of earning rate display (Scapia, OneCard) but limited evidence of transaction-level "why you earned this" explanations in Indian market. Global B2B platforms (Yotpo) show the pattern works, but consumer credit card implementation details are sparse in sources.

---

## SUMMARY

- No Indian digital card shows post-transaction earning explanations in sources, only category rates upfront
- PIXEL can differentiate with simple notification-based autopsy before building complex prediction or social features
- Medium confidence due to limited transaction-level display examples but clear whitespace in market

choices.title: Transaction-Level Earning Explanations
choices.summary: Display specific reasons why each transaction earned its cashback rate at the transaction level, not just category rates.
choices.rationale: Competitors like Scapia and OneCard show category rates upfront but don't provide detailed transaction-level explanations for why specific rates were applied.

choices.title: Real-Time Conversion Transparency
choices.summary: Show clear, real-time conversion of rewards to currency value with visual indicators at point of earning.
choices.rationale: While Scapia shows conversion ratios (5 coins = ₹1), there's opportunity to make this more prominent and real-time at transaction moment.

choices.title: Predictive Earning Insights
choices.summary: Display potential earning rates before transactions based on merchant category and user's spending patterns.
choices.rationale: None of the competitors show predictive earning information to help users optimize their spending decisions before making purchases.
